summary: The new Levi squad hides Eren and Historia. Pastor Nick is killed, the government demands the two of them, and Kenny steps out of Levi's past.

segments.ja: エレンは、壁の向こうの海を、アルミンの言葉として思い出します。思い出す海は、まだ地図にありません。ない海より先に、今日の仕事は掃除と警備です。新しいリヴァイ班は、エレンとヒストリアを同じ屋根の下に置いています。置く理由は、二人を守ることです。守る屋根は、トロスト区の静かな家に見えます。見える静けさは、もう長く続きません。続かない静けさを、班はまだ日常と呼んでいます。
segments.en: Eren remembers the sea beyond the walls as Armin's sentence. The sea he remembers is not on a map yet. Ahead of the sea that is not there, today's work is cleaning and guard duty. The new Levi squad keeps Eren and Historia under the same roof. The reason for keeping them there is to protect the two of them. The roof looks like a quiet house in Trost District. The quiet that can be seen will not last. The squad still calls the quiet that will not last an ordinary day.

segments.ja: ハンジは、エレンの巨人化で壁の穴を塞ぐ実験を続けています。続ける実験は、今日も完成しません。完成しない体は、肉が足りず、距離も足りません。足りない結果を、リヴァイは資材の節約としては悪くないと言います。悪くない作戦が、エレン一人の体に掛かっています。掛かっている体が、まだ壁の材料になりません。ならない日が、また一日増えます。増えた一日の先に、別の敵が来ます。
segments.en: Hange is still running the experiment of plugging the wall's hole with Eren's titanization. The experiment she continues is not finished today either. The unfinished body does not have enough flesh, and it does not have enough distance. Levi says the insufficient result is not a bad saving of materials. The plan that is not bad hangs on Eren's body alone. The body it hangs on is not yet material for a wall. Another day is added to the days that do not become that. A different enemy comes ahead of the added day.

segments.ja: 司祭ニックが、トロスト区の兵舎で殺されます。殺され方は、巨人の事故ではありません。爪を剥がされた跡が、拷問を示します。示す相手は、中央の憲兵です。サネスという名が、ハンジの前に立ちます。立つ男は、強盗だと片づけようとします。片づけは通りません。通らない現場が、調査兵団への狼煙になります。狼煙は、協力した人間を消す煙です。煙の色は、血です。
segments.en: Pastor Nick is killed in a barracks at Trost District. The way he is killed is not a Titan's accident. The marks of torn nails show torture. The people the marks show are the interior military police. A man named Sannes stands in front of Hange. The standing man tries to tidy it away as a robbery. The tidying does not pass. The scene that does not pass becomes a smoke signal to the Survey Corps. The signal is smoke that erases a person who cooperated. The color of the smoke is blood.

segments.ja: ハンジは、ニックがどこまで話したかを、爪の枚数から推測します。推測は、全部剥がされても口を割らなかった、です。割らなかった信仰を、リヴァイはバカだと言い、しかし曲げなかった事実は認めます。認めた事実が、レイス家をこちらが知っているかどうかは、まだ中央に確定していません。確定していないことが、わずかな時間です。時間は、命令が届くまでの長さしかありません。長さは、一晩もありません。
segments.en: Hange guesses, from the number of nails, how far Nick talked. The guess is that his mouth did not break even when all of them were torn. Levi calls the faith that did not break foolish, and he still admits the fact that it did not bend. Whether the interior has settled that this side knows the Reiss family is not yet fixed. What is not fixed is a little time. The time is only as long as it takes an order to arrive. The length is not even one night.

segments.ja: エルヴィンからの伝令は、撤収です。壁外調査は凍結され、エレンとヒストリアを渡せ、と中央が言っています。言っている相手は、団長の部屋にまで憲兵を送っています。送られた圧力は、もう裏工作の大きさではありません。大きさは、公の犯罪者扱いです。扱いを、リヴァイはなりふり構わない、と要約します。要約のあと、家の痕跡を消す命令が出ます。
segments.en: The message from Erwin is withdrawal. Expeditions beyond the walls are frozen, and the interior says to hand over Eren and Historia. The people saying it have sent military police as far as the Commander's room. The pressure that was sent is no longer the size of a backroom scheme. The size is a public treatment of criminals. Levi summarizes the treatment as no longer caring how it looks. After the summary, the order comes to erase the traces of the house.

segments.titleEn: Why take them, not kill them
segments.ja: ハンジが残す問いは、殺すのではなく手に入れたい理由です。理由が、壁の秘密と繋がっています。繋がった秘密を、ヒストリアはまだ自分の中に見つけていません。見つけていない彼女を、敵はクリスタの名で追います。追う名と、本人が捨てた役は、同じ顔です。同じ顔を、エレンは隣で歩かせられます。歩かせる街は、王の記念日で混んでいます。混んだ街が、隠れ場所にも戦場にもなります。両方になる街を、班は歩きます。
segments.en: The question Hange leaves is the reason they want to obtain the two, not kill them. The reason connects to the wall's secret. Historia has not yet found the connected secret inside herself. The enemy chases her, who has not found it, under the name Christa. The name they chase and the role she dropped are the same face. Eren is made to walk beside that same face. The city they are made to walk is crowded with a royal anniversary. The crowded city becomes both a hiding place and a battlefield. The squad walks the city that becomes both.

segments.ja: 街の中で、エレンとヒストリアが素人の男たちにさらわれます。さらった相手は、中央の制服ではありません。ではありませんが、目的は二人です。二人を押さえたリヴァイ班は、リーブスという商人を拘束します。拘束した男は、街の物流を握っています。握っている力を、調査兵団は敵の顔を見るために使います。使う作戦は、替え玉です。替え玉の中に、アルミンがヒストリアの側として座ります。
segments.en: In the city, Eren and Historia are taken by men who are not professionals. The people who took them do not wear the interior's uniform. Even so, the target is the two of them. The Levi squad, having pinned the two down, restrains a merchant named Reeves. The restrained man holds the flow of goods in the city. The Survey Corps uses the power he holds in order to see the enemy's face. The operation they use is a substitute. Inside the substitute, Armin sits on Historia's side.

segments.ja: リヴァイは、中央の憲兵が素人を使わない、と言います。言ったあと、今日の賊が素人であることに引っかかります。引っかかる記憶は、子供のころ一緒にいた男です。男の名はケニーです。ケニーは、都で憲兵の喉を裂いた伝説として、ニファの口に残っています。残っている伝説を、リヴァイは実在だと言います。言うタイミングは、馬車が動き出す直前です。直前の一言が、配置の読みになります。読みは、今度は当たります。
segments.en: Levi says the interior military police do not use amateurs. After saying it, he snags on the fact that today's kidnappers are amateurs. The memory he snags on is a man he lived with as a child. The man's name is Kenny. Kenny remains in Nifa's mouth as a legend who cut the throats of military police in the capital. Levi says the legend that remains is real. The timing of saying it is just before the wagon starts to move. The one sentence just before becomes a reading of the arrangement. This time the reading is right.

segments.en: Kenny's way of following is the diagonal rear of the target, and a high place with a view. Levi sees the high place before he can tell Nifa. At the moment he sees it, guns sound. The guns that sound erase some of the squad from the street. The opponent that erases them uses bullets, not blades. A battlefield of bullets is different from the ODM gear the Survey Corps is good at. Kenny's squad holds the different weapon on the roofs. Kenny himself is at the front of the squad that holds it. His gun sounds first.

segments.en: Kenny calls Levi with the remainder of a child. The voice that calls is light even in the middle of killing. Under the light voice is the two men's old sharing of a house. There is no time today to explain the past that is there. Without that time, Levi dodges bullets and Kenny runs the roofs. The two who run look both like teacher and student, and like enemy and ally. The relationship that can be seen is the side that takes Eren and the side that takes him back. The sides are the real source of this smoke signal. The source is the wall's secret.

segments.en: The substitute in the operation does not reach Kenny's main body. While it does not reach, the real Eren and Historia pass into other hands. Where they passed is not yet known. Levi pursues the unknown destination from the bullet marks in the city. The squad that pursues has already lost people. With the reduced number, the next pain begins. The opponent of the beginning is the interior itself. One face of that interior was made visible by Kenny. The face that was made visible shoots while it laughs.

segments.en: The Commander is accepting the freeze of the survey on the surface. Behind what he accepts, he is trying to identify the enemy in the interior. The materials of the identification are Nick's death, Historia's blood, and Eren's power. If they obey the order to hand the power over, the road to the basement and the hole in the wall both close. In order not to close them, the Levi squad steps outside the law. The city does not yet know that they stepped out. The flags of a royal distribution sway in the city that does not know, under the king's name.

The materials of the identification are Nick's death, Historia's blood, and Eren's power. If they obey the order to hand the power over, the road to the basement and the hole in the wall both close. In order not to close them, the Levi squad steps outside the law. The city does not yet know that they stepped out. The flags of a royal distribution sway in the city that does not know, under the king's name.

vocab.exampleJa: 増えた一日の先に、別の敵が来ます。
vocab.exampleEn: Hange is still running the experiment of plugging the wall's hole with Eren's titanization. The experiment she continues is not finished today either. The unfinished body does not have enough flesh, and it does not have enough distance. Levi says the insufficient result is not a bad saving of materials. The plan that is not bad hangs on Eren's body alone. The body it hangs on is not yet material for a wall. Another day is added to the days that do not become that. A different enemy comes ahead of the added day.

vocab.exampleJa: 立つ男は、強盗だと片づけようとします。
vocab.exampleEn: Pastor Nick is killed in a barracks at Trost District. The way he is killed is not a Titan's accident. The marks of torn nails show torture. The people the marks show are the interior military police. A man named Sannes stands in front of Hange. The standing man tries to tidy it away as a robbery. The tidying does not pass. The scene that does not pass becomes a smoke signal to the Survey Corps. The signal is smoke that erases a person who cooperated. The color of the smoke is blood.

vocab.exampleJa: 見つける騒ぎの横で、ヒストリアはユミルの不在を抱えています。
vocab.exampleEn: Jean, Sasha, Connie, Mikasa, Armin. They still cannot measure why they were chosen. While they cannot measure it, Sasha hides food and Jean finds it. Beside that noise, Historia is holding Ymir's absence. The absence she holds is a face that has already dropped the role of the good child. Eren says the dropped face is not unnatural. After he says it, the Captain comes back. The face that came back already knows the experiment's result.

vocab.exampleEn: Today's smoke signal is not a fire far away. It is a killed priest, guns that sounded, and two people who vanished. The three signs point at the same interior. The interior they point at erases people in order to protect the wall's secret. Historia enters the people it erases, and Eren enters them. Levi has to take the two who entered back from the man in his past. The night in which he must take them back has already started.

vocab.exampleEn: The message from Erwin is withdrawal. Expeditions beyond the walls are frozen, and the interior says to hand over Eren and Historia. Levi summarizes the treatment as no longer caring how it looks. After the summary, the order comes to erase the traces of the house.

vocab.exampleEn: In the city, Eren and Historia are taken by men who are not professionals. The people who took them do not wear the interior's uniform. Even so, the target is the two of them.
